  ▝▝   ▝▝   /rig/project-a


 ❯ Summarise what project-a does, and what it should do next.

 ● project-a is a small TypeScript module with one export: the greet function in src/app.ts takes a name and returns a greeting string built from it, with no state and no side effects, so it is safe to call from anywhere
   and trivial to test. The next step is a farewell function beside it that mirrors greet exactly, followed by one test file that covers the pair, so the module keeps a single shape that any reader can take in at a
   glance.

   - greet: returns a greeting for a name
   - farewell: will return a farewell for a name

   Both functions stay pure.

 ✻ Cogitated for 0s · done 12:00 PM

   Then cover both functions with one small test file.
